issues.description: Cluster inventory: 11 epithelial clusters are reported for the 5–22 pcw human fetal lung scRNA-seq, but the Markdown only names five labels (tip, stalk, airway progenitors, AT2, AT1); remaining cluster labels/markers cannot be recovered from the text.

Organoid scRNA-seq identifies pulmonary neuroendocrine (NE) precursors as a cell population, but no NE marker genes are named in the Markdown, so L4 pulmonary neuroendocrine cell markers cannot be verified from this paper.
HTII-280 is used as an AT2/tip marker in the paper, but it is an antibody/protein reagent rather than a standard gene symbol; it was not entered as a gene-based marker.

task.paper_title: Organoid modeling of human fetal lung alveolar development reveals mechanisms of cell fate patterning and neonatal respiratory disease.
